payload.friendly_name: Charter offering, activation presets and the doctrine-to-charter cutover
payload.purpose_context: Earlier renames kept old names working, leaving two names for one thing: agents and contributors get confused and users' harnesses contradict themselves. Following ADR 2026-10-06-1, a Charter Pack becomes a bundle of charter components plus activation presets applied with charter activate --pack/--preset, the doctrine command group and skill names are cut over in one step, and one upgrade migration rewrites existing projects so nothing silently loses activated artifacts.
payload.purpose_tldr: Replace the retired doctrine-pack vocabulary with one charter vocabulary across CLI, config, skills, code and docs, with activation presets as pack data and no compatibility layer.

payload.question: Should this mission also fold in #5825 (the built-in tier spelled 'built-in' vs 'builtin', and pack-path literals with no single home), or only its path half (.kittify/doctrine / charter-packs constants), leaving tier spelling to #5825?

payload.final_answer: Path half only (B): the mission centralises the .kittify/doctrine / .kittify/charter-packs path constants it already moves; the built-in vs builtin tier spelling stays in #5825 (41 src sites in 22 files, 132 test sites, and a consumer-visible JSON value such as charter context --json "source": "builtin", so A is not trivial).

payload.final_answer: A: reset every per-artifact [] key to absent and name each in the upgrade summary with the command to switch the kind off again (owner, 2026-10-06)
